title: Insurance Pre-Auth and Claim File Preparation for Hospitals
summary: Assemble cashless pre-auth, enhancement and final claim files for TPAs, insurers and government schemes, and check each against the payer's checklist before submission.

seo.title: Hospital Pre-Auth and Claim File Preparation | VipraTech
seo.description: AI for hospital insurance desks: pre-fill cashless pre-auth forms, check payer document checklists, flag non-payable items and draft TPA query replies.

designed_for: Head of TPA and Insurance Desk

problem.intro: A hospital insurance desk handles cashless requests for many insurers, TPAs and government schemes, each with its own forms, portals and document checklists. A pre-auth needs the request form, doctor's notes, investigation reports, a cost estimate and policy and ID documents; the final claim adds the bill breakup, discharge summary, pharmacy bills and implant invoices. One missing report or a mismatch between estimate and notes brings a query, and the patient waits at discharge.

pain_points.title: Payer-specific checklists
pain_points.detail: Each TPA, insurer and scheme asks for slightly different documents and formats, and desk staff keep the differences in their heads.

pain_points.title: Queries and deficiency letters
pain_points.detail: Missing investigation reports, unsigned notes or unclear line items trigger queries that delay approval and discharge.

pain_points.title: Mismatches across documents
pain_points.detail: The diagnosis on the pre-auth, the procedure in the OT notes and the package on the final bill do not always line up.

pain_points.title: Deductions found too late
pain_points.detail: Non-payable items, room-category issues and missing implant documentation surface only at settlement.

solution.overview: We build a claim file assistant for the hospital insurance desk. When a cashless request starts, it gathers the patient's policy or e-card, ID, doctor's notes, investigations and estimate from the HIS, fills the payer's pre-auth form fields and checks the file against that payer's checklist. For enhancements and final claims, it compares the bill breakup with the discharge summary, OT notes and approved amount, highlights likely non-payable items and missing documents, and drafts replies to TPA queries using the relevant pages of the record. Desk staff review and submit through the payer portal, or through NHCX where the hospital is onboarded. Every file keeps a log of what was sent and when.
capabilities: Payer-specific document checklists for insurers, TPAs, PM-JAY, CGHS, ECHS and state schemes, maintained by your desk
Pre-fills pre-auth and enhancement form fields from HIS data and clinical notes
Cross-checks diagnosis, procedure, package and dates across notes, estimate and final bill
Highlights likely non-payable items and room-category issues before submission
Drafts replies to TPA queries with the relevant pages of the patient record attached
Tracks each file's submission, query and approval history

workflow.title: Open the case
workflow.detail: When a cashless admission is registered, the assistant opens a case and pulls policy, ID and clinical documents from the HIS.

workflow.title: Prepare the pre-auth
workflow.detail: Form fields are pre-filled and the file is checked against the payer checklist, with gaps listed for the desk.

workflow.title: Desk review and submission
workflow.detail: Desk staff close the gaps, review the file and submit it through the payer portal or NHCX.

workflow.title: Queries and enhancements
workflow.detail: Payer queries are read, the right documents found and a reply drafted; enhancements are prepared when the treating team revises the plan.

workflow.title: Prepare the final claim
workflow.detail: At discharge, the bill breakup is checked against the discharge summary, OT notes and approvals, and missing documents are flagged.

workflow.title: Submit and track
workflow.detail: The final file is submitted after desk review and its status is tracked through to settlement.

inputs: Policy or e-card, patient ID with masked Aadhaar, and scheme card
Doctor's admission notes and treatment plan
Final bill, itemised breakup, pharmacy and implant invoices
outputs: Payer checklist status with missing items
Draft query replies with supporting documents attached
human_in_the_loop: Insurance desk staff review and submit every file, and treating doctors confirm any clinical statement in a query reply. The assistant never submits to a payer or changes clinical content on its own.
integrations: Hospital information system (billing, clinical and pharmacy modules)
National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX) where the hospital is onboarded
PM-JAY and state scheme portals, through desk-uploaded packs
Email inbox used by the insurance desk
guardrails: No claim, query reply or enhancement submitted without desk review
Clinical statements drafted only from signed notes and confirmed by the doctor before sending
Masked Aadhaar only; full numbers never stored, per UIDAI rules
Payer checklists versioned so every change is traceable
Access limited to insurance desk roles, with full audit logging
compliance_notes: Helps hospitals meet payer documentation requirements and IRDAI's expectations on faster cashless processing; claim decisions remain with insurers and TPAs.
Patient health data processed only for claim purposes, in line with the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: Cashless files for two or three high-volume TPAs or insurers in one department, prepared in parallel with the current desk process.
deliverables: Checklists and form mappings for the pilot payers
Working assistant connected to HIS exports
Comparison report against recent files and their query history
Roll-out plan for remaining payers and schemes

what_we_measure.how: Checklist gaps found by the assistant compared with the queries payers later raised.
Queries received on pilot files compared with recent files for the same payers.
Time from admission to pre-auth submission, and from discharge order to final claim submission.
Desk feedback on whether each consistency and non-payable flag was valid.

faqs.q: Does it work with government schemes like PM-JAY?
faqs.a: Yes, as checklists and package mappings. Scheme portals have their own rules on access, so the assistant prepares and checks the documents and the desk uploads them through the official portal.

faqs.q: Will it decide what we bill?
faqs.a: No. Billing stays with your billing team and claim decisions with insurers and TPAs. The assistant flags items that commonly attract deductions so your team can review them before submission.

faqs.q: Can it reply to TPA queries automatically?
faqs.a: It drafts replies and attaches the relevant documents. Desk staff, and the treating doctor where clinical content is involved, review and send them.

faqs.q: How do you keep payer checklists current?
faqs.a: Your desk team owns the checklist library through a simple admin screen. Changes are versioned, and each file shows which checklist version it was checked against.
